anomaly.label_policy: Freeze scores and thresholds before reading windows. Known public benchmark, no label-based tuning. Intersect windows with evaluation period; report clipping. Not official NAB score.
anomaly.metrics: raw point flags vs benchmark windows; emitted alerts spaced by >=60 min; event hit requires emitted alert inside window; delay from evaluation-window start, not fault onset; no point adjustment

segmentation.transform: log1p + RobustScaler, fit at first origin only; no clipping
segmentation.rules: priority: R>90 dormant; else F==1 once; else R<=30 and F>=3 active; else regular
segmentation.stability: Refit scaler and KMeans on each 80% no-replacement sample; predict all first-origin customers. ARI plus Hungarian-aligned per-cluster retention.
segmentation.temporal: Frozen scaler and centers assign second-origin 180-day features. Compare common customers; count entrants/exits separately.
segmentation.future: 30-day positive-order return and gross sales, computed after assignments; descriptive association only, not causal uplift.
segmentation.scope: all countries, valid positive merchandise transactions with customer IDs; exclude cancellations, nonpositive prices/quantities, nonmerchandise codes, exact duplicate rows; gross not net revenue; anonymous customer codes
